Video.summary: Get ready for a high-octane showdown as the Arena Championship Series East rolls into the DCU Center in Worcester, Massachusetts! The action is fierce across JCB Racing, the Two Wheel Skills Challenge, and the Freestyle competition as top-tier drivers battle for the BKT overall event championship. Rivalries ignite on the dirt as veteran Jon Zimmer faces off against the youngest driver in the game, Montana Robbins, while Coty Saucier looks to settle a deep-seated score with Triton Robbins. Expect gravity-defying bicycles, massive sky wheelies, and 12,000-pound trucks catching massive air in this unforgettable Mother's Day event.
Video.title: DCU Center - Worcester, MA
